2377: function shiftNightOperatingDate(day,direction){
2378:   let d=new Date(`${day}T12:00:00`);
2379:   const step=Number(direction)>=0?1:-1;
2380:   for(let i=0;i<62;i++){
2381:     d.setDate(d.getDate()+step);
2382:     const key=dateKey(d);
2383:     if(isNightOperatingDay(key))return key;
2384:   }
2385:   return day;
2386: }

2482: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){
2483:   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
2484:   if(typeof value==='object')value=value.formattedValue||value.value||value.date||value.serial||'';
2485:   const text=String(value).trim();
2486:   if(/^\d{5}(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(text)){
2487:     const serial=Number(text),utc=new Date(Math.round((serial-25569)*86400000));
2488:     if(!Number.isNaN(utc.getTime()))return `${utc.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(utc.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(utc.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2489:   }
2490:   const full=text.match(/(20\d{2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})/);
2491:   if(full)return `${full[1]}-${full[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${full[3].padStart(2,'0')}`;
2492:   const compact=text.replace(/\D/g,'');
2493:   if(/^20\d{6}$/.test(compact))return compact.slice(0,4)+'-'+compact.slice(4,6)+'-'+compact.slice(6,8);
2494:   const monthDay=text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*(?:월|[.\-/])\s*(\d{1,2})(?:\s*일)?(?:\D|$)/);
2495:   if(monthDay){const year=String(basis||dateKey(today)).slice(0,4)||'2026';return year+'-'+monthDay[1].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+monthDay[2].padStart(2,'0');}
2496:   const parsed=new Date(text);
2497:   if(!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()))return `${parsed.getFullYear()}-${String(parsed.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(parsed.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2498:   return text.slice(0,10);
2499: }

9375: function timetableWeekLabel(value) {
9376:   const base = new Date(`${String(value || dateKey(new Date()))}T12:00:00`);
9377:   if (Number.isNaN(base.getTime())) return "주간 선택";
9378:   const day = base.getDay();
9379:   base.setDate(base.getDate() + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day));
9380:   const end = new Date(base); end.setDate(end.getDate() + 4);
9381:   const md = d => `${d.getMonth()+1}/${d.getDate()}`;
9382:   return `${md(base)} ~ ${md(end)}`;
9383: }

9375: function timetableWeekLabel(value) {
9376:   const base = new Date(`${String(value || dateKey(new Date()))}T12:00:00`);
9377:   if (Number.isNaN(base.getTime())) return "주간 선택";
9378:   const day = base.getDay();
9379:   base.setDate(base.getDate() + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day));
9380:   const end = new Date(base); end.setDate(end.getDate() + 4);

9382:   return `${md(base)} ~ ${md(end)}`;
9383: }

1659: function dormRuleNormalizeDateTime(value){
1660:   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='') return '';
1661:   // Google Sheets 날짜 직렬값은 시트의 '현지 날짜/시간' 값이다.
1662:   // UTC instant로 해석한 뒤 Asia/Seoul을 다시 적용하면 +9시간이 생기므로,
1663:   // 직렬값의 날짜/시간 성분을 그대로 추출한다.
1664:   if(typeof value==='number'||/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(String(value).trim())){
1665:     const serial=Number(value);
1666:     if(Number.isFinite(serial)&&serial>20000&&serial<100000){
1667:       const d=new Date(Date.UTC(1899,11,30)+Math.round(serial*86400000));
1668:       if(!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())){
1669:         const y=d.getUTCFullYear(),m=String(d.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0');
1670:         const hh=String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2,'0'),mm=String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
1671:         return `${y}-${m}-${day}T${hh}:${mm}`;
1672:       }
1673:     }
1674:   }
1675:   const raw=String(value).trim().replace(' ','T');
1676:   const m=raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})T(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
1677:   if(m) return `${m[1]}-${String(m[2]).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(m[3]).padStart(2,'0')}T${String(m[4]).padStart(2,'0')}:${m[5]}`;
1678:   return String(value).trim();
1679: }

190: function uepDiagSafe(value,depth=0){
191:   if(depth>6)return '[DEPTH_LIMIT]';
192:   if(value==null||typeof value==='number'||typeof value==='boolean')return value;
193:   if(typeof value==='string')return value.replace(/[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/gi,'[EMAIL_REDACTED]').slice(0,4000);
194:   if(Array.isArray(value))return value.slice(0,30).map(v=>uepDiagSafe(v,depth+1));
195:   if(typeof value==='object'){
196:     const out={};
197:     for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(value)){
198:       if(/token|secret|password|authorization|cookie|credential|private|email|name/i.test(k)){out[k]='[REDACTED]';continue;}
199:       out[k]=uepDiagSafe(v,depth+1);
200:     }

6776: function uniqueActiveAlertStudents(rows=[]){

6778:   const validIds=new Set(students.map(s=>String(s.id||s.studentId||'').trim()).filter(Boolean));
6779:   const validNos=new Set(students.map(s=>String(s.studentNo||s.number||'').trim()).filter(Boolean));
6780:   const seen=new Set(),out=[];
6781:   for(const row of rows){
6782:     const id=String(row?.studentId||row?.id||'').trim(),no=String(row?.studentNo||row?.number||'').trim();
6783:     const hasKnownIdentity=(id&&validIds.has(id))||(no&&validNos.has(no));
6784:     if((validIds.size||validNos.size)&&!hasKnownIdentity)continue;
6785:     const key=(id&&validIds.has(id)?id:'')||(no&&validNos.has(no)?no:'')||`${row?.classNo||row?.classLabel||''}|${row?.name||''}`;
6786:     if(!key||seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);out.push(row);
6787:   }
6788:   return out;
